mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( COMMENT_NO , COMMENT_CONTENT , REF_BNO , COMMENT_WRITER , CREATE_DATE , STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_CNO.NEXTVAL , #{commentContent} , #{refBno} , #{commentWriter} , SYSDATE , DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_NO commentNo , COMMENT_CONTENT commentContent , REF_BNO refBno , COMMENT_WRITER commentWriter , CREATE_DATE createDate FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND REF_BNO = #{refBno} ORDER BY commentNo DESC
